Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?

You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree) from all academic backgrounds

You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business

You are a creative problem-solver

You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset

You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning

You thrive in a team environment

You have excellent interpersonal skills

You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

You are fluent in English & Dutch

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?

The program is structured as follows:

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values

Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools

Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce

Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Reporting to the Senior Director of the SOX team focusing on Quote to Cash End-to-End Business Processes, this role requires strong discernment, emotional intelligence, and the ability to transform business knowledge into useful solutions. This person will also be responsible for applying business knowledge into the systems, process or reporting solutions that are proposed and delivered for an effective control environment.

Your Impact

Work cross-functionally to support a changing SOX landscape and drive process improvement - we are strategic advisors to the company!

Provide end-to-end business knowledge and expertise to assist in SOX readiness activities and SOX program maturation activities

Take ownership for all assigned process areas, which includes acquiring a comprehensive grasp of business process activities and controls as well as related company policies and external accounting and reporting guidelines and act as a subject matter authority for each of these assigned areas

Assist in the development of the annual SOX prioritization assessment and plan

Work with current functional teams within the organization to review current processes and identify risk areas and areas for improvement and design controls around these to reduce risk and exposure to avoid operational surprises as well as evaluate and assess deficiencies

Bring your knowledge and experience designing, implementing and testing internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR) per the Sarbanes-Oxley Act to respond to identified risks

Partner with the business to ensure SOX documentation, including flowcharts, narratives, and controls are up to date, accurate and properly handled

Collaborate with functional teams for compliance to outlined processes and ensure that all key controls are being performed satisfactorily

Work effectively in a dynamic, high growth environment, think quickly and creatively, recognize interrelationships early and enable innovation

Drive breakthrough solutions, encourage shifts in approach, and build the momentum to help excel Salesforce to $50 billion and beyond

Required Qualifications

5+ years of related audit & accounting experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Strong background in public company SOX compliance requirements, accounting, and finance processes, including a solid understanding of the concepts of control design and operational efficiency

Strong knowledge/experience with key business processes including Quote-to-Cash, Order-to-Cash, ASC 606 and auditing requirements including Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) requirements and US GAAP

MuleSoft’s Professional Services team works across every technology and system to deliver solutions to customers in every industry. Your Impact

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.

Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud and/or a relevant competing platform.

Experience in system integration or management consulting services.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

Skills for analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and mapping business requirements into technical features.

Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.

AI and Data literacy. AI literacy includes understanding AI concepts like machine learning, agentic AI, responsible use and ethical implications. Data literacy involves data modeling, data strategy and analytics.

Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.

Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.

Build Trust at the C-Level: Become a trusted advisor to CIO/CTO/EA-level contacts and their teams as they look to transform their business.

Lead Enterprise Architecture Engagements: Understand VW's business strategy and technology needs, identify key capabilities, and clearly link them to business outcomes.

Drive the Solution Vision: Be accountable for the development of ROI-driven business case documents, visioning proposals, enterprise architecture artifacts, solution roadmaps, and executive presentations.

Mentor and Guide: Share your expertise by mentoring sales, pre-sales, and customer resources on strategic opportunities.

The builder mindset we’re looking for We are looking for someone who wants to help shape how Enterprise Architecture is done in the age of AI. We want a seasoned Business Architect or Transformation Leader who will explore new ways of working and help us turn those experiments into realizable business outcomes. Enterprise/Chief Architect background with a CRM, Data, or Customer Experience focus.

Strong communication and executive presence with C-level clients (CIO/CTO/CDO).

Business-fluent German and English (C1/C2).

Based in Germany (Berlin, Frankfurt, Munich, Düsseldorf) or remote work close to the customer's offices.

Familiarity with modern Digital Operating Models, Transformation programs, and design thinking frameworks.

Understanding of cloud platforms, integration patterns, and architectural principles.

Experience navigating European data sovereignty, compliance, and trust concerns, particularly regarding enterprise AI adoption.

Solid grasp of probabilistic modeling, statistical evaluation, and the use of simulation-based testing to validate complex models and systems.

Proficiency in modern ML frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Prior experience working within cross-functional teams that include data scientists, operations research specialists, and software engineers.

About the Role

The Business Value Services (BVS) team serves as trusted value advisors to our Global Public Sector, Education, and NGO customers. This role will be focused on the Nonprofit sector, making this Nonprofit experience critical. We bridge the gap between Salesforce capabilities and customer business outcomes by quantifying value, articulating ROI, and enabling account teams to speak the language of business decision-makers. As a BVS Specialist, you'll partner with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, and customer stakeholders to build compelling business cases, craft strategic value messaging, and accelerate deal velocity across government agencies, educational institutions, and nonprofit organizations.

-------------------------
What You'll Do

Value Discovery & Business Case Development
- Lead value discovery workshops with customers to identify business goals, pain points, and success metrics
- Build quantified business cases using a combination of tools demonstrating ROI, TCO advantages, and financial impact
- Create compelling value maps that connect organizational goals to Salesforce capabilities and measurable outcomes
- Translate technical solutions into business value narratives that resonate with C-suite executives and budget decision-makers

Strategic Proposal Development
- Collaborate with account teams to craft value-infused proposals and executive presentations
- Develop sector-specific messaging for Federal, State & Local Government, Education, and NGO markets
- Position Salesforce solutions (Public Sector Solutions, Education Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, etc.) in the context of mission-critical challenges
- Incorporate customer success metrics, industry benchmarks, and Forrester TEI studies into sales materials

Sales Enablement & Advisory
- Serve as a value-selling subject matter expert for account teams across your assigned territory/accounts
- Conduct "office hours" and advisory sessions to coach AEs and SEs on value-selling best practices
- Enable self-service value capabilities by training teams on BVS tools and methodologies
- Partner with Solution Engineers to integrate value narratives into technical demonstrations

Customer Engagement & Relationship Building
- Present business cases and ROI analyses to customer executives, procurement teams, and budget committees
- Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across IT, finance, and lines of business
- Support value realization efforts post-sale to demonstrate ongoing impact and support expansion opportunities
- Participate in strategic customer events including Agentforce World Tours, executive briefings, and industry conferences

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Industry Advisory, CSG (Customer Success Group), Professional Services, and Product teams
- Contribute completed business cases to the BVS ROI Library for organizational learning
- Share best practices and learnings across the global BVS community
- Support special projects and strategic initiatives as identified by BVS leadership

-------------------------
What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications
- 8+ years of professional experience in one or more of: management consulting, business analysis, sales engineering, pre-sales, customer success, or public sector advisory roles
- Deep understanding of Public Sector, Education, or NGO environments including procurement processes, budget cycles, compliance requirements, and stakeholder ecosystems
- Strong analytical and financial modeling skills - comfortable building ROI models, TCO analyses, and benefit quantification
- Exceptional communication skills - ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business narratives for executive audiences
- Demonstrated success in value-based selling or advisory engagements with measurable business outcomes
- Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously with minimal supervision
- Willingness to travel occasionally (10-20%) for customer meetings, team events, and industry conferences

Preferred Qualifications
- Salesforce experience - either as a customer, implementation partner, or Salesforce employee (certifications a plus)
- Public Sector domain expertise in areas such as grants management, case management, licensing & permitting, constituent services, emergency response, or student lifecycle management
- Background as a former industry practitioner - experience working in government agencies, school districts, universities, or nonprofit organizations
- Consulting or advisory firm experience (e.g., Big 4, boutique consulting, or specialist firms)
- Technical background - understanding of CRM systems, platform architecture, integration patterns, or data management
- Previous sales or customer-facing roles within SaaS, enterprise software, or technology companies
- Salesforce Certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Sales/Service Cloud Consultant
- MBA or relevant advanced degree in business, public administration, policy, or related field

-------------------------
The Ideal Candidate Profile

Based on successful BVS team members, you likely have:
- Experience as a former industry leader, senior consultant, or public sector practitioner

- Ideal candidates will have consultative experience working with nonprofit organizations.

- Demonstrated familiarity and facility with nonprofit metrics and standard reporting structures such as Form 990s
- Multiple Salesforce certifications demonstrating platform expertise
- Background in CSG (renewals/NNAOV) or account management roles
- 8+ years at Salesforce or equivalent experience in enterprise SaaS
- Experience as a former builder or administrator who understands the technical implementation side
- Domain expertise that matches customer buyer personas - you've been in their shoes and can relate to their challenges

You bring:
- Curiosity - you ask thoughtful questions to uncover the real business drivers
- Relationship focus - you build trust and become a valued advisor, not just a resource
- Analytical rigor - you're comfortable with both qualitative insights and quantitative modeling
- Multi-cloud expertise - you understand how to position the full Salesforce portfolio (Core, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, Agentforce)
- Business acumen - you think like a consultant and can translate value into executive language

-------------------------
Why Join BVS?

- High-impact role - your work directly influences multi-million dollar deals and helps government agencies, schools, and nonprofits modernize their operations
- Diverse engagements - no two deals are the same; work across Federal agencies, state governments, K-12 districts, universities, and mission-driven nonprofits
- Collaborative culture - join a tight-knit team of value experts who actively share knowledge and support each other
- Growth opportunities - develop executive presence, strategic consulting skills, and deep Salesforce product expertise
- Flexible work environment - remote-friendly with occasional travel for high-impact customer meetings and team gatherings
- World-class enablement - access to tools like BVD, Highspot, Trailhead, and continuous

About the Role
We are seeking a Lead ML Engineer, LLM Post-Training Infrastructure to join the Salesforce AI Research Incubation Team. In this role, you will own the infrastructure and engineering systems that support LLM post-training, large-scale evaluation, and model deployment. You will build scalable, reliable
pipelines for training orchestration, rollout generation, reward and feedback pipelines, experiment management, and model iteration, helping translate research ideas into production-grade systems.

This is an engineering-first role focused on ML infrastructure, distributed systems, and training/evaluation workflows rather than developing new model architectures or algorithms. You will work closely with research scientists, agent engineers, and platform teams to operationalize post-training and feedback-driven learning methods into robust, reusable systems.This is a lead-level individual contributor role with deep ownership of model-facing infrastructure and strong cross-functional influence.

Key Responsibilities:
● Design, build, and maintain infrastructure for LLM post-training, evaluation, and
deployment.
● Own scalable pipelines for training orchestration, rollout generation, reward and
feedback processing, checkpointing, and experiment management.
● Build reliable systems for feedback-driven model improvement, including human or AI
feedback loops, large-scale offline evaluation, and regression detection.
● Partner closely with research scientists to turn new post-training methods into reusable
engineering workflows.
● Collaborate with agent engineers and platform teams to integrate training and evaluation
systems with production model and agent stacks.
● Optimize distributed training and inference workloads for reliability, throughput, cost
efficiency, and observability.
● Drive best practices for reproducibility, versioning, monitoring, deployment, and
operational excellence across ML systems.

Required Qualifications:
● 5+ years of experience in software engineering, ML systems, or distributed
infrastructure.
● Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production systems or large-scale
ML pipelines.
● Hands-on experience building infrastructure for model training, post-training, evaluation,
or serving.
● Experience designing reliable, scalable systems for distributed and GPU-based
workloads.
● Strong debugging skills across systems, pipelines, and model-facing failures.
● Experience building infrastructure for LLM post-training, including RLHF, preference
optimization, reward modeling, or related feedback-driven training workflows.
● Experience working cross-functionally with research scientists and engineers.
● Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containerized environments (Docker,
Kubernetes).

Preferred Qualifications:
● Experience with rollout systems, large-scale evaluation loops, or training data/feedback
pipelines.
● Familiarity with distributed training frameworks and modern ML infrastructure stacks.

Salesforce is looking to expand our GDC Latam team by hiring a hardworking and passionate Solution Architect.

This role sits within Customer Success and is accountable for product adoption being systematically designed, consistently measured, and scalable across Salesforce’s multi-cloud platform.

You will work closely with Salesforce Product teams to define adoption frameworks that reflect product intent, customer usage, and value realization, while establishing common standards and signals that enable adoption to be delivered consistently through AI agents, digital experiences, in-app channels, and expert-led engagements.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the definition and evolution of Salesforce’s Product Adoption Framework, establishing a standardized model that connects product usage to customer outcomes across the lifecycle, in partnership with Product teams

Partner with Product teams to define and maintain feature-level adoption paths for each cloud, ensuring paths are outcome-oriented, usage-based, and grounded in real customer behavior

Ensure adoption considerations are embedded early in product design, not retrofitted post-launch.

Define and standardize adoption metrics, signals, and thresholds that reflect meaningful product usage and value realization, and ensure these signals are consistently leveraged across Customer Success Score and Attrition Risk Insights

Design and run continuous adoption experiments to identify friction, validate assumptions, and improve adoption velocity based on observed customer behavior and data

Partner with Product and Customer Success offer teams to ensure adoption frameworks and signals are delivered at scale through AI agents, digital experiences, in-app channels, and expert-led engagements.

Align with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure adoption frameworks are embedded into instrumentation, GTM workflows, and customer engagement models.

Drive improvements in feature utilization and time-to-value, and strengthen adoption signals that inform expansion and attrition decisions, enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to execute adoption-led growth.

Build and lead a high-performing adoption team within Customer Success, setting a high bar for product thinking, analytical rigor, and execution in a highly matrixed environment

Minimum Requirements:

15+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, with senior leadership roles spanning Product, Customer Success, Growth, or Platform Strategy

Demonstrated experience operating in a platform company with a complex, multi-product portfolio

Executive presence and communication skills, with strong judgment and the ability to operate effectively with senior leaders across Product, Customer Success, and Sales

Proven ability to define and scale product adoption frameworks across multiple products or clouds, including feature-level adoption paths and usage-based measurement

Strong product and platform fluency, including experience influencing product design, instrumentation, and in-product adoption mechanisms

Experience defining or leveraging product usage instrumentation and telemetry to drive adoption insights and decisions

Strong analytical fluency, with experience interpreting adoption and usage data, partnering effectively with analytics teams, and using data to inform experimentation and decisions

Experience leading experimentation (e.g., A/B testing, usage analysis, behavioral insights) to improve product adoption or engagement

Proven ability to drive outcomes in highly matrixed environments, influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Customer Success

Experience building systems or frameworks that enable revenue growth and retention, without direct ownership of commercial targets

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

Role Description
Salesforce is seeking a transformational Regional Vice President (RVP), Analytics to lead the UK & Ireland Analytics business. This role is a key member of the UKI Sales Leadership Team and is responsible for driving the strategy, performance, and growth of the Analytics portfolio across the region.

This second-line leader will oversee a high-performing organization comprising three teams of Account Executives, responsible for expanding Salesforce’s Analytics footprint across the UK and Ireland. The portfolio spans Tableau, CRM Analytics, and Data Cloud, and plays a critical role in enabling customers to unlock value from their data and power the next generation of AI-driven enterprises.

The Regional Vice President will be responsible for growing top-line revenue, accelerating new business acquisition, and driving expansion across the existing customer base. Success in this role requires building a scalable, repeatable go-to-market engine, supported by structured operating rhythms, rigorous pipeline management, and strong cross-functional collaboration across the Salesforce ecosystem.

Beyond delivering strong commercial outcomes, this leader will serve as a strategic business leader, trusted customer partner, and talent multiplier, helping Salesforce customers transform data into actionable intelligence while building and developing the next generation of sales leaders.

In an era where data is the foundation and AI is the differentiator, Salesforce Analytics sits at the center of the modern enterprise technology stack. This role will play a pivotal part in helping organisations across industries transform raw data into insight, insight into action, and action into competitive advantage. Ideal candidates should bring deep experience in B2B enterprise sales—specifically within Business Intelligence (BI), Data Analytics, or Big Data—and demonstrate a proven ability to lead teams in achieving exceptional results.

Your Impact

Team Development: Cultivate a diverse, high-performing team, positioning them as "Data Strategy" consultants who can help customers move from "gut-feel" to data-driven decision making.

Recruiting and Training: Oversee the hiring and onboarding of Account Executives, ensuring they can articulate the value of a "Data Culture" and the technical benefits of the Salesforce Analytics stack.

Customer Engagement: Support AEs in high-stakes meetings, providing executive presence and helping clients navigate the journey from fragmented data silos to a "Single Source of Truth."

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the Data Cloud and MuleSoft teams to ensure Analytics is positioned as the visualization and insight layer of the Salesforce platform.

Pipeline Generation: Lead targeted initiatives to identify "Analytics-first" opportunities within the UKI Enterprise and Commercial landscapes.

Strategic Mentorship: Guide AEs on navigating the shift toward Autonomous Analytics (Agentforce for Analytics) and how to sell the ROI of faster, smarter insights.

C-Level Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with Chief Data Officers (CDOs), CIOs, and CFOs within customer organizations.

Go-To-Market Strategy: Develop and execute the UKI GTM strategy for Analytics, ensuring alignment with global Tableau/Salesforce objectives and local market trends.

Sales Forecasting: Provide accurate, data-backed reporting on pipeline health and revenue forecasts to Area Sales Management.

Team Spirit: Champion an inclusive, winning culture that empowers team members to excel in a technical and fast-evolving market.

Ideal Candidate Skills and Experiences

Proven Sales Leadership: Minimum 10 years of experience in enterprise software sales, with a track record of leading teams to over-achieve quotas in the BI or Data space.

Analytics & SaaS Expertise: Deep understanding of the Business Intelligence landscape, data visualization (Tableau), and how data underpins the success of AI/ML initiatives.

Team Building: Proven ability to coach AEs to move beyond "feature selling" to "value-based storytelling" with data.

Strategic Thinking: Proficient in aligning analytics solutions with broader business goals like operational efficiency, churn reduction, and revenue growth.

As the Sr. Director for the Office of the CEO, you will lead the strategic vision and execution of our cloud security posture, assess, challenge, and guide highly technical security implementations spanning Agentforce, Data Cloud, and platform infrastructure. You will manage an elite organization of security engineers and managers focused on building automated, scalable security controls that protect our multi-cloud substrate. You will test the trust boundary to improve security by design, define and assess tools to secure development and ultimately, view every AI-powered solution with a lens for scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and business impact before they reach customers at enterprise scale.

This is not a traditional engineering management role. The Sr. Director will operate as an extension of the CEO’s leadership team, providing independent technical judgment on complex implementations, identifying opportunities to modernize and consolidate legacy systems, and drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization that includes Engineering, Security, Product, Infrastructure, Finance, and Go-to-Market. The successful candidate will bring deep firsthand experience delivering results across cloud hyperscalers, a track record of replacing legacy services with secure AI-driven solutions, and the organizational credibility to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities:

Security Evaluations & Technical Governance:

Drive security alignment across a complex landscape of "dotted-line" stakeholders. You will partner with Cloud Business Units (CBUs) and Product Engineering to ensure security is baked into the "Golden Path" of development without sacrificing velocity.

Lead the shift-left movement by ensuring all security controls are delivered via Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible. You believe that if a security policy isn't in code, it doesn't exist.

Translate complex technical constraints and architectural trade-offs into clear strategic recommendations for C-suite and VP-level stakeholders.

Partner with engineering organizations to define and pressure-test multi-year platform roadmaps, focusing on identity and access management (IAM), data protection, and threat detection within AWS and GCP environments, ensuring secure technical execution is tightly aligned with business objectives.

Act as a key member of the Security Architecture Council, providing expert guidance on zero-trust architectures, service mesh security (Istio), and container security (Kubernetes/GKE).

Technical Evaluation & Architectural Oversight:

Evaluate highly technical AI implementations across Salesforce’s product and infrastructure portfolio, providing the Office of the CEO with independent assessments of architectural soundness, security rating, scalability, and operational readiness.

Conduct deep-dive reviews of distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and AI/ML-driven services, identifying risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for consolidation or modernization.

Assess build-vs-buy decisions and integration approaches for AI-powered capabilities, drawing on hands-on experience with large-scale commerce and platform infrastructure.

AI-Driven Modernization & Legacy Transformation:

Drive strategy and evaluation of initiatives that replace legacy services with AI-enabled platforms, leveraging experience decommissioning legacy systems at scale and delivering measurable cost optimization.

Technical Acumen: While your primary focus is leadership, you stay "hands-on" enough to conduct design reviews and understand the nuances of backend automation in Python or Golang.

Required Experience & Skills:

Executive Leadership: 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and engineering leadership, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles (Director or above, managing managers preferred).

Cloud-Native Security Mastery: Deep technical expertise across cloud hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Kubernetes (K8s) security. You understand the unique threat vectors of containerized environments.

Security-as-Code Mindset: Proven track record of implementing security controls through Infrastructure-as-Code and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Matrix Navigation Skills: Exceptional ability to lead by influence. You have a "Diplomacy-First" approach to resolving conflicts between security requirements and product feature deadlines.

Engineering Pedigree: Strong backend foundation in Python, Golang, or Java. You speak the same language as our core platform engineers. Strong technical foundation in cloud infrastructure, system architecture, and multi-cloud platform development and optimization.

AI & ML Education: Graduate degree in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a closely related field, which includes hands-on experience beyond academia.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience securing B2C-scale distributed systems (billions of transactions).

Current, active U.S. Government Security Clearance of Top Secret or above.

Experience working with U.S. federal government or Department of Defense customers.

About Us:
At Salesforce, we are at the forefront of the AI Era, where high-quality, reliable data is the cornerstone of superior AI outputs. Our Resource Management Operations (RMOPs) team plays a pivotal role in ensuring this quality data is maintained and leveraged effectively to inform business decisions around demand and capacity management.
 

Job Description

In the AI Era, our business decisions are only as good as the data feeding them. Your role is to support the continuous delivery of high-quality, reliable data within our Resource Management systems and enable Resource Managers to work more efficiently while reducing time-to-staff across the organization. This function is directly impacting the company's ability to scale, innovate, and deploy the right talent at the right time.

In this role, you will serve as a Steward of Quality Data. ROM Ops will help drive global consistency and not only ensure that Leadership can make informed decisions with trusted data, but that ROM’s can become more efficient in their day to day and reduce time to staff. You aren't just watching the data; you are driving global consistency and taking direct action to optimize our Resource Management lifecycle and You will be a data integrity specialist who doesn’t just "clean" data, but understands the why behind it—someone who can spot a trend before it becomes a bottleneck.

Day to Day responsibilities

Utilization Tracking: Ensure the data is the "source of truth" for our capacity. Your goal is to minimize "bench time" (unassigned staff) and prevent burnout (over-assigned staff).

Capacity Coordination: Regularly sync with Project Managers (PMs) to understand current team bandwidth. When a project nears its end date, you’ll lead the Assignment Extension process or flag the resource as "available" for new work.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other Project Delivery Teams and RMs and identify process challenges and escalate accordingly.

Reporting & Compliance: Generate weekly "Status Reports" to flag missing assignments or expired opportunities, ensuring the leadership team is making decisions based on accurate data.

Systems Thinking: The ability to see how an "Opportunity" in one stage triggers a "Resource Assignment" in the next.

Status Reporting: Flag "Ghost Assignments" (staff assigned to projects that haven't started) and "Expired Assignments" (staff still billing to closed projects).

Data Hygiene Stewardship:
Act as the primary owner of data cleanliness within Salesforce PSA. This includes:

You are comfortable with—and take pride in—high-volume data entry and administration. You ensure every project, person, and hour is accounted for in our systems

Reconciling Assignments, Cleaning up "zombie" opportunities that lack active action plans.

Standardizing naming conventions and entry protocols.

Perform monthly audits to ensure that what’s happening in the "real world" matches what’s in our Resource Management Tool.

Change Management & Process Adoption

Process Enhancement: Analyze current workflows to identify operational bottlenecks and develop scalable solutions for implementation.

Process Advocacy: Act as the "go-to" person when we roll out new operational workflows. You’ll help the team transition from "the old way" to "the better way."

Continuous Improvement: Evaluate process efficiency and recommend enhancements to streamline data entry and operational workflows.

Documentation & Training: Create "light-touch" documentation (checklists, short videos, or 1-pagers) that makes it easy for the team to follow the Resource Management and Data Hygiene protocols.

Hold stakeholders accountable to data standards. You’ll be the one reminding a busy PM that a clean system helps everyone succeed.

Efficiency Driver: Identify friction points in the ROM day-to-day workflow and Improve the efficiency of ROMs in their daily operations. Your goal is to automate or streamline processes to significantly reduce time-to-staff.

Skills & Experience:

Candidates with relevant overall work experience ranging from 12months to 24 months

You can "manage up" and "manage sideways," getting answers from busy leaders without being a bottleneck. Maintain accountability standards for data integrity by ensuring stakeholder compliance with established protocols and system requirements.

Professional Communication: Demonstrate ability to effectively communicate across organizational levels, obtaining necessary information from senior leadership while maintaining operational efficiency

Collaborative Leadership: Foster cross-functional partnerships and team coordination

Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to data accuracy.

Data & AI Technical Architect - Job Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. Agentforce is Salesforce's newest innovation—a next-generation platform that combines Data + AI + CRM + Trust to transform customer experiences. Our AI and Data Architect team is a startup within a global organization, dedicated to helping Salesforce customers and prospects design and implement cutting-edge solutions that deliver real business value.

Role Description

As an AI and Data Technical Architect, you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

You will:

Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.

If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!

Responsibilities

Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

Get it Done – Drives processes that scale. Challenges the organization to think with a beginner’s mind and act efficiently to achieve the desired outcome. Calm, organized, positive, and can-do attitude. Results-driven, tenacious, drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

Motivate and Champion – Invests in and tries new things in the talent and career development of our people. Holds self and team accountable to expectations.

Salesforce Smart – Explains the vision and “the why” behind changes. Keeps teams focused and moving forward, even in an absence of concrete information, by rallying them around a vision.

Win as a Team – Puts the collective benefit of the company first. Brings teams together to take-on shared goals. Seeks and embraces different points of view and experiences to unlock the collective potential of people across Salesforce.

Your Impact:

Address and resolve customer issues as a leader representing Salesforce.

Proactively identify renewal risks and develop action plans and strategies to mitigate risk.

Develop an in-depth understanding of your customers’ business and critical priorities, and align Salesforce solutions to them.

Work closely with peers and selling partners on capacity planning for Signature obligations.

Lead oversight on critical customer issues, working across Support, Critical Incident Center, and Engineering until resolution is achieved.

Build strong multi-functional working relationships with Solutions, Sales, Engineering, and Product Management.

Serve as Director-level escalation and pursue each critical issue as an opportunity to drive the customer relationship.

Track and identify frequently occurring, high impact issues and communicate through appropriate channels for resolution.

Develop strategies to improve the customer experience, team performance, morale, and cohesion with other internal teams.

Collaborate on talent retention strategies, encompassing career pathing, promotions, and ongoing training.

Ensure teams are proficient in New Product Introductions (NPI) and New Service Introductions (NSI) initiatives.

Stay informed on market trends, risks, and opportunities specific to customers and industries, communicating insights to Territory & OU leaders.

Overall 15+ years of experience & possess a minimum of 5+ years in leadership roles with direct experience in customer success and team management.

Exhibit strong critical thinking and ability to use data and insights to identify trends and risks.

Entrepreneurial and "lead from the front". You’re a proven leader and motivator, with deep experience leading technical organizations. You drive results and outcomes while balancing empathy and a people-first culture.

Experience working with Enterprise-level customers.

Job Description

The Enterprise Cloud Architect is a customer-facing enterprise domain expert applying broad technical skills, with deep industry knowledge and business acumen, supporting sales teams in developing Salesforce value propositions that align to our customers’ business strategies on digital transformation and cloud adoption. The Enterprise Cloud Architect is a subject matter expert in one or more categories that may include: business strategy, application architecture, data & information, integration, security, cloud computing, technology, distributed platforms, mobile, and analytics. With a strong blend of technical and sales skills the Enterprise Cloud Architect uses a consultative approach to understand business and technical requirements.

The Enterprise Cloud Architect determines which Salesforce and third party technologies to leverage in customer driven architectures, based upon product knowledge, industry experience, industry standard EA frameworks and Salesforce EA methodologies.

With a broad IT background including solution architecture, technical architecture, software/systems engineering, cloud computing, governance and SDLC, the Enterprise Cloud Architect leads key discussions and considerations around change programs from both a business and technical perspective.

The Enterprise Cloud Architect helps the sales teams develop industry specific, repeatable propositions and go to market strategies.

The Enterprise Cloud Architect also participates in the delivery of solution best practices, reference architectures, educational sessions and industry summits to existing customers, partners and to internal audiences.

Your Impact - Responsibilities

• Business planning and strategy

• Become a trusted advisor to CIO/CTO/EA level contacts and their teams as they look to move their business to a cloud architecture

• Earn the trust of prospects' and customers’ CISO/CSO/Chief Risk Officer and similar.

• Present Salesforce technology infrastructure, including demonstrating deep familiarity with company's platform capabilities, hosting infrastructure, security and integration capabilities

• Understand the customer need and establish company's product as the best solution that addresses the technical and business requirements

• Conduct architecture and technical workshops that may include enablement sessions

• Manage customer technical due diligence and risk management processes

Role Overview

As a White Space Hunter for our Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) UKI team, you will be the tip of the spear for net-new logo acquisition. Reporting directly to the RVP of Pharma, you will own a high-value territory of "must-win" enterprise accounts that do not yet have a foundational relationship with our platform.

This is a pure hunter role. You will navigate some of the world’s most complex, highly regulated, and globally distributed organizations—from pharmaceutical giants and MedTech innovators to large-scale healthcare providers.

You will own the UKI footprint, identifying "white space" where our platform can drive transformation. While you lead local execution, you will work in lockstep with global teams to ensure UKI-specific wins align with broader worldwide strategies. This is a unique opportunity to build a high-impact career by landing new business within the world's most complex corporate structures.

The Territory Dynamics

You will be responsible for breaking into a curated portfolio of enterprise accounts across three primary pillars:

Global Biopharma: Multi-national organisations focused on R&D, clinical trials, and global commercialization.

Medical Technology & Diagnostics: Leaders in surgical innovation, diagnostic imaging, and life sciences laboratory services.

Healthcare Services & Distribution: Major private healthcare groups and pan-European pharmaceutical wholesalers.

Key Responsibilities

Execute the "Hunter" Playbook: Identify, prospect, and penetrate net-new enterprise accounts within the UKI HLS sector.

Strategic Mapping: Build comprehensive maps of "white space" opportunities within complex corporate hierarchies, identifying key stakeholders across IT, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical operations.

Value-Based Selling: Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, focusing on patient-centricity, digital transformation, and operational efficiency in a regulated environment.

Orchestrate the Win: Lead a cross-functional "deal pod" (Solution Engineers, Industry Advisors, and Partners) to deliver tailored, high-impact visions to C-suite executives.

Pipeline Excellence: Maintain rigorous discipline in prospecting and forecasting, ensuring a healthy and predictable multi-year pipeline.

The Ideal Candidate: Mindset Over Tenure

We are looking for a high-potential seller who thrives on the "thrill of the chase" and has the strategic patience to win long-cycle enterprise deals.

The Hunter Instinct: You have a proven track record of opening doors in "locked" accounts. You are energised by the challenge of building a presence from zero.

Intellectual Curiosity: You are a fast learner. You are eager to master the nuances of the HLS landscape—from GxP compliance and clinical data silos to the evolving digital needs of Commercial Excellence and Medical Affairs departments.

Executive Presence: You can navigate a boardroom and hold your own with CIOs, CMOs, and Digital Transformation leaders.

Resilience & Coachability: You view "no" as a request for more information. You are a fast learner who actively seeks feedback to sharpen your sales craft.

Complex Problem Solving: You don't just sell software; you solve business bottlenecks for organisations that impact global human health.

Why Join This Team?

High Visibility: This role offers a direct line of sight to leadership and a clear path for career acceleration into the upper echelons of enterprise sales.

Purpose-Driven Work: The organisations you target are at the forefront of medical innovation; your success directly enables better patient outcomes.

Industry Leadership: You’ll be backed by the world’s #1 AI CRM, Agentforce, and industry-specific clouds (Health Cloud and Life Sciences Cloud) built for this exact market.

Innovation at Scale: You will be at the forefront of the AI Revolution, helping the world's leading HLS companies deploy autonomous agents to improve patient and HCP experiences.

What is an Account Solution Engineer?

Also known as a “Presales”, “Solution Advisor”, “Sales Consultant,” or “Sales Engineer” the Account Solution Engineer is responsible for owning the solutions throughout the sales cycle and delivering thought leadership to companies to transform their customer’s experience. The Account SE is an expert who works alongside their colleagues, participates in building our team culture and supports their aligned sales team to create solutions for prospects and customers.
To ensure our impact is both deep and relevant, our Solution Engineers specialize by industry. For this role, you will focus on the Manufacturing vertical in the Netherlands—working with process and discrete manufacturers to optimize operations, enhance supply chain visibility, and drive digital transformation.
To accomplish this, you should have a strong desire to set the vision translating business objectives into enticing and practical recommendations. The Account SE acts as a trusted advisor to our customers while aiding the customer’s transformational journey.

Your Responsibilities

Enable Digital Transformation: Partner with customers to shape their digital journeys using market-leading CRM and AI Agent technology tailored to industry needs.

Trusted Advisory: Listen to customer needs and translate business challenges—from production planning to aftermarket service—into recommendations that demonstrate clear value to both business leaders and IT stakeholders.

Solution Orchestration: Coordinate with internal teams to design tailored solution concepts and technical Proof of Concepts (POCs) that address real-world manufacturing challenges.

Technical Engagement: Build and share compelling demonstrations that highlight the capabilities of the Salesforce platform and our partner ecosystem, with a focus on manufacturing use cases.

Relationship Building: Present compelling solutions while developing industry expertise and articulating benefits to stakeholders at every level, from plant floor supervisors to C-level executives. Bridge the gap between initial vision and program execution by driving deeper platform adoption and measurable business impact.

Drive Value & Consumption
Bridge the gap between vision and execution by ensuring customers maximize their investment. You will partner with Success Managers to track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify underutilized features, and propose roadmap expansions that drive deeper platform adoption and measurable business impact.

Personality Attributes & Experience

Consultative & Empathetic: A background in solution engineering, consultancy, or software delivery with a natural ability to connect business goals to technology.

Communication & Connection: Good presentation and interpersonal skills, with a talent for explaining complex ideas in an engaging and accessible way.

Growth Mindset: A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn, experiment, and share new knowledge with the wider team.

Collaborative Spirit: A proven ability to contribute to and support teams in dynamic, evolving environments. We value diverse perspectives and encourage everyone to bring their unique voice to the table.

Diverse Backgrounds Welcome: Track record of solution engineering, consultancy, delivery, or training success. We are open to a variety of backgrounds for this role. Experience will be evaluated based on core proficiencies (e.g., extracurricular leadership, work experience, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

Language & Location: Fluency in Dutch and English is required. Willing and able to travel occasionally throughout the Netherlands.

Salesforce Ecosystem: Experience with Salesforce (or similar) solutions (Sales, Service, Data 360, Agentforce,..). Salesforce certifications are a plus but not an absolute requirement.

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with or an interest in manufacturing use cases, including production planning (S&OP), supply chain optimization, and digital twins.

Solution & Communication Skills: Ability to understand customer business goals and map those to the right technology solutions on the Salesforce platform and within our ecosystem of partners. Solid verbal, written, and presentation skills.

AI Literacy: Comfort and proficiency using AI assistants and tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Perplexity,...) to work more efficiently and deliver greater value.

Note: The company language is English, including corporate communication and meetings.

If this sounds like you, even if you don't tick all the boxes, we really encourage you to apply. At Salesforce, we value diverse perspectives and non-linear career paths. If you're passionate about this role and the financial services industry, we want to hear from you.

The Technical Architect - DevOps is responsible for advising, designing, and managing deployment orchestration solutions for complex Salesforce implementations. This role requires close collaboration with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, Solution Architects, and Account Teams, as well as direct client engagement to architect DevOps solutions tailored to their needs.

The Technical Architect - DevOps ensures solutions align with industry best practices to drive long-term customer success. This hands-on role involves architectural work and, when necessary, deployment execution. You are both a big-picture thinker and an in-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise. You take pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical demands while balancing technical and enterprise-level considerations.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations.

Assess existing DevOps processes, tools, and practices, recommending improvements.

Design, present, and implement best-fit DevOps solutions, considering customer needs, tool preferences, and commercial constraints.

Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies.

Lead DevOps design sessions, architect solutions, and document best practices.

Develop and enforce DevOps frameworks and governance models for consistency across deployments.

Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.

Ensure successful continuous delivery deployments across environments.

Support pre-sales activities, including discovery sessions, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept (PoC) development.

Collaborate with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations.

Travel to client sites as needed (estimated 50-75%).

Requirements (Technical Skillset)

9+ years of CRM experience, with at least 8 years on the Salesforce platform.

Expert knowledge of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Experience, Industries (Vlocity), and Data Cloud.

Strong understanding of environment management, release management, version control best practices, and deployment methodologies.

Understanding of branching strategies such as Git Flow, Trunk-based development, Feature branching

Salesforce Development Lifecycle – Metadata API, SFDX (Salesforce DX), Salesforce CLI, Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Salesforce Release & Deployment Strategies – Sandbox management, Source-driven development, Change sets, Unlocked & Managed Packages.

Experience with CI/CD tools: Copado, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI.

Experience with Version Control Systems - Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Azure Repos.

Strong grasp of software configuration management (Chef) and release management.

Experience with Docker image building, orchestration, and pipelines.

Experience with test automation (Provar, TOSCA, TestNG, Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, JMeter, ApexUnit).

Experience managing code quality tools (e.g., SonarQube, Checkmarx, PMD).

Understanding of Performance Monitoring – Salesforce Event Monitoring, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor.

Experience with security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Technology, or equivalent experience.

Salesforce certifications (active or ability to obtain upon hire).

Experience is evaluated based on core proficiencies, including leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, and professional background.

Account Executive - Secteur Public (Tableau )

Tableau aide le monde entier à voir et à comprendre les données. En tant que cœur analytique de l'écosystème Salesforce, notre plateforme permet aux organisations de transformer des données complexes en décisions stratégiques grâce à l'IA et aux agents intelligents.

Le secteur public est le marché qui connaît la croissance la plus rapide chez Salesforce au niveau mondial. En France, Tableau affiche une croissance annuelle moyenne de 65 % sur les cinq dernières années.

Nous avons posé les fondations ; nous entrons désormais dans une phase d'accélération massive. Nous recherchons un(e) Account Executive de haut niveau pour piloter l'expansion de Tableau auprès des collectivités territoriales (Régions, Départements, Métropoles et Communes).

En tant qu'ambassadeur de notre solution, vous êtes responsable du développement de Tableau sur votre territoire. Vos objectifs principaux :

Stratégie de conquête : Définir et exécuter des plans de comptes audacieux alignés sur les agendas de transformation des acteurs publics locaux.

Vente de valeur : Créer des relations de haut niveau (C-Level) et positionner Tableau comme le socle décisionnel stratégique des collectivités.

Cycle de vente complet : Piloter l'intégralité du cycle, de la prospection à la négociation finale, dans un environnement complexe et concurrentiel.

Leadership d'équipe (Matrix Management) : Orchestrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire (Sales Consultants, BDRs, Services, Marketing, Customer Success) pour maximiser l'impact de chaque deal.

Impact Citoyen : Accompagner les décideurs publics dans l'optimisation de leurs budgets et l'amélioration de la transparence et des services rendus aux citoyens.

Votre Profil 

Nous recherchons un(e) "hunter" stratégique capable de naviguer dans des cycles de vente multi-interlocuteurs.

Expérience : Vous justifiez d'un parcours solide dans la vente de logiciels (SaaS) ou de solutions complexes. Une connaissance du secteur public français est un atout majeur.

Mindset : Vous êtes stimulé(e) par la conquête de parts de marché et l'ouverture de nouveaux territoires.

Compétences : Excellentes capacités de négociation, rigueur dans le forecast et curiosité intellectuelle pour maîtriser une solution technique de pointe.

Soft Skills : Leadership collaboratif, agilité face au changement et une volonté de devenir un expert reconnu sur le marché de l'Analytics.

Pourquoi rejoindre Tableau (Salesforce) ?

Un produit leader : Travaillez pour la plateforme analytique de référence, boostée par les dernières innovations en IA.

Une culture d'excellence : Rejoignez une équipe performante où l'innovation et l'impact social vont de pair.

Une opportunité d'évolution : Dans un marché en pleine explosion, votre succès aura un impact direct sur le leadership de Salesforce en France.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Si vous êtes ambitieux(se), stratégique et motivé(e) par la création de valeur concrète pour le service public, postulez dès maintenant.

About the Role 
The Sales Strategy team is a vital strategic partner, supporting the sales leadership team as a trusted advisor focused on strategic planning, sales optimization, and business operational support. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including finance, employee success, marketing, recruiting and operations.

This is a high-impact position with evolving priorities. You will be empowered to think strategically, design focused execution plans, and guide those plans to fruition. Your projects will range from high-level strategy to vital operations, focusing on areas such as Go-To-Market planning, playbooks, territory alignment, data quality, market segmentation, and business performance reviews.
 

We are looking for passionate candidates who possess a deep curiosity, an agile mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to navigate ambiguity effectively while managing multiple priorities.
 

How You Will Make an Impact:

Strategic Planning: Lead and collaborate on the design and implementation of the Go-To-Market plan during the annual sales strategy cycle. This includes partner segmentation, resource allocation, territory assignment, and quota setting.

Data-Driven Insights: Define key performance metrics and targets. Build reports and dashboards to derive actionable insights into business health, identify areas for growth, and present strategic recommendations to sales leadership.

Market Analysis: Conduct ad-hoc analyses across multiple data sets and tools (e.g., customer segmentation, sales participation, propensity to buy, white space).

Operational Excellence: Guide forecast management to ensure sustained, predictable growth across business units, and coordinate weekly forecast calls to track sales pursuits.

Executive Storytelling: Create compelling executive-level presentations for local and global leadership reviews, and organize quarterly business reviews.

Process Improvement: Proactively troubleshoot operational issues as they surface, proposing systemic and process changes to address root causes.

What You’ll Bring (Required):

Strategic Background: Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or strategic business operations—ideally within an online/startup, SaaS, or sales/business development environment.

Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and German.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to turn complex data into actionable strategies.

Mindset: A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a focus on achieving shared goals in a fast-paced environment.

Collaboration: An open, communicative approach with a clear desire to learn, grow, and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.

Curious - always asking why

Agentforce is Salesforce's newest innovation—a next-generation platform that combines Data + AI + CRM + Trust to transform customer experiences. Our AI and Data Architect team is a startup within a global organization, dedicated to helping Salesforce customers and prospects design and implement cutting-edge solutions that deliver real business value.

Role Description

As an AI and Data Technical Architect, you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.
 

You will:

Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
 

If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!
 

Responsibilities

Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.
 

Requirements

Technical Pre-Sales/Consulting - 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.
 

Preferred Requirements

Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

Advanced AI/ML Frameworks - Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

Education - BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent technical field.

Orchestrer et diriger des guides de solutions transversales, et les aligner à la stratégie d'opportunité.

Développer et livrer l'histoire de l'expérience client aidée par les technologies Salesforce.

Participer à toutes les formations et certifications appropriées sur les produits, les ventes et les procédures pour acquérir et maintenir les connaissances essentielles afin d'être efficace dans le poste.

Capacité à voyager en fonction de l'alignement du territoire et de la région.

Connaissance des applications connexes, des bases de données relationnelles et des technologies web.

Solides compétences en communication orale, écrite, en présentation, en collaboration et en relations interpersonnelles.

Capacité à travailler en équipe pour résoudre des problèmes techniques dans des environnements politiques variés.

Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle.

Au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de pré-vente en contact avec la direction.

We are seeking a Government Affairs Manager to join our US State & Local team. Based in New York City, you will be responsible for Salesforce policy priorities across the Northeast, with a primary focus on New York and Massachusetts. This role requires a minimum of three days in our New York City office every week.

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for state and local policymakers, trade associations, and civic organizations across the Northeast. You will champion a policy agenda focused on AI, Data Privacy, and Digital Transformation. By serving as a bridge between Salesforce and policymakers, you will proactively shape the regulatory environments that impact our customers and our community.

Responsibilities

Strategic Advocacy: Represent Salesforce’s interests before Governors, State Legislatures, Mayors, and City Councils. You will drive policy outcomes on issues that impact our customers and our community.

Political Intelligence: Act as an early-warning system by analyzing legislative and regulatory trends. You’ll translate "government-speak" into actionable business insights for our executive leadership.

Executive Briefing: Prepare high-level briefings for our executive leadership team for interactions with key policymakers.

Coalition Building: Lead our engagement with trade associations and civic organizations to amplify our voice.

Strategic Events & Programming: Partner with our Marketing and Events teams to integrate government stakeholders into Dreamforce, World Tours, and local events. You will oversee VIP protocols and compliance for public official attendance.

Corporate Diplomacy: Manage the regional budget for political contributions, event sponsorships and community-based initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience

Regional Expertise: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in government, public policy, or advocacy. Deep, existing relationships in Albany and New York City are essential.

Policy Literacy: A proven ability to dissect complex state and municipal legislation and communicate the impact on the technology sector.

Process Literacy: Knowledge of legislative process and key inflection points for advocacy.

Agility: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and execute on management of simultaneous projects. You can pivot from a legislative hearing to a high-level internal strategy call without missing a beat.

Communication: Exceptional writing skills—capable of drafting everything from a "one-pager" for a policymaker to an internal Slack update for the global team.

Ownership & Alignment: Ability to work independently and take initiative, yet 100% in coordination with the team

Travel: Ability to travel up to 20%.

Desired Skills & Experience

The Tech Lens: Experience working for a multinational global SaaS/Cloud/AI company.

Campaign Mindset: Experience in candidate or issue-based campaigns where you had to build a movement from the ground up.

Multi-Jurisdictional Reach: Direct experience navigating the political climates of additional Northeast states

The Product Enablement team leverages the power of the Trailhead platform - Salesforce’s award-winning, gamified learning experience - to deliver world-class learning to employees around the globe. We combine deep expertise in instructional design with a strong command of the Salesforce product suite to create scalable, high-impact training programs that serve diverse roles, regions, and experience levels.

Our vision is to build the most productive and high-performing sales teams by delivering innovative enablement that accelerates product mastery worldwide. Trailhead is a core engine behind that vision - powering how our global employees build expertise, stay ahead of rapid product innovation, and confidently bring Salesforce solutions to market.

As the Technical Lead for Agentforce Sales, you will accelerate one of our most critical assets: field product excellence. You will lead the strategy, design, and scaling of engaging, best-in-class product enablement for Agentforce Sales and Revenue Management, leveraging Trailhead and immersive hands-on training to ensure our sellers and solution engineers are ready to win. You are the architect behind learning experiences that operate seamlessly at global scale - experiences that are interactive, innovative, and built to drive real performance outcomes. This role combines product depth, systems thinking, and executional rigor - giving you the opportunity to accomplish the best work of your life while enabling thousands of customer-facing professionals to do the same.

Responsibilities:

Own and execute global employee enablement programs for Agentforce Sales and Agentforce Revenue Management, including Trailhead content and live hands-on training.

Design and develop Trailhead content that is engaging, fun, and relevant to internal employee audiences, including trails, badges, hands-on challenges, and micro-learning content.

Design, develop, and deliver live hands-on training for technical sellers, including virtual workshops and in-person hands-on training at employee events (e.g. Company Kick-off, Pre-Dreamforce).

Own the org strategy for internal hands-on training for Agentforce Sales and Agentforce Revenue Management, partnering closely with Solutions, Specialists, and Product to identify gold-standard resources and scale org provisioning.

Support delivery of business-critical quarterly learning content aligned to specific cloud and cross-cloud strategic initiatives (e.g. new product launches, release readiness, etc.)

Develop, deliver, and test agentic components for internal Trailhead content (e.g. Sales Coach, Agentforce Quizzes, Slackbot, etc.)

Complete 3x/annual content maintenance cycles, updating all owned content with messaging and feature changes, in partnership with product stakeholders.

Drive project management and stakeholder management for all owned product learning content, ensuring seamless communication across product and field readiness teams.

Create scalable content for a global audience, producing learning that applies across multiple industries and geos, and finding innovative ways to tailor material for different learner profiles. 

Anticipate and understand changing product, audience and business drivers and adapt to meet those needs.

Develop and maintain subject matter expertise on Salesforce products, with a focus on Agentforce Sales and Revenue Management.

Be accountable for on-time, high-quality delivery of all owned content releases, proactively managing risks to deadlines.
 

Experience/Skills Desired:

Demonstrated product expertise in Agentforce Sales and/or Agentforce Revenue Management.

Experience with technical sales and/or post-sales, strongly preferring experience with Salesforce sales methodology and processes.

Aptitude in instructional design principles (including adult learning theory) and live training delivery. 

Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Experience with AI/LLM technologies to build and deliver instructional content (e.g. using generative AI for assessments or simulations).

Familiarity with Salesforce enablement platforms (Trailhead) and project management tools.

Ability to balance high standards for quality with the need to get to market fast.

Demonstrated ability for creative thinking and project management leading complex projects with minimal oversight.

Self-starter that thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and fluctuating environment.

Ability to travel up to 25%.

Global Public Sector
